The PDF is image/compressed content in the fetch output, so I’ll extract its text locally with the sandbox’s PDF utility and inspect the fish-bag calculation.
```python
pdf_text = await run_command("curl -L --max-time 30 -s 'https://journals.le.ac.uk/index.php/jist/article/download/733/684/1496' -o ./hiccup_paper.pdf && pdftotext -layout ./hiccup_paper.pdf - | grep -i -A8 -B8 'volume\\|bag' | head -80")
print(pdf_text)
```
The extracted passage should show the equation and the resulting volume directly; I’m checking the full text around the numerical value if the first filter missed it.
```python
full_pdf_text = await run_command("pdftotext -layout ./hiccup_paper.pdf - | grep -E -A5 -B5 '0\\.1777|0\\.0016|Eq\\. \\(4\\)|bag' | head -120")
print(full_pdf_text)
```
0.1777 m³
